dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, do we have any chilies?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, duː wiː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈtʃɪliz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, there are some in the fridge. Are they very spicy?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðɛr ər sʌm ɪn ðə ˈfrɪdʒ. ər ðeɪ ˈvɛri ˈspaɪsi?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Very! We only need two. Do you have any oil?
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri! wiː ˈoʊnli ˈniːd ˈtuː. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈɔɪl?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: There's some oil, but there isn't any pepper.
dialogue.reading: ðɛrz sʌm ˈɔɪl, bʌt ðɛr ˈɪzənt ˈɛni ˈpɛpər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's OK. Do you have any limes?
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈlaɪmz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, I don't. Do we need limes?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈdoʊnt. duː wiː ˈniːd ˈlaɪmz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! A lot of Thai food has lime in it.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd ˈhæz ˈlaɪm ɪn ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Then let's buy some limes and some pepper.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈlɛts ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈlaɪmz ənd sʌm ˈpɛpər.
